profile.title: Frontend Developer & UI Designer
profile.tagline: Crafting sun-soaked digital experiences from the Aegean coast.
profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Jane, a frontend developer with 6+ years of experience building clean, user-first web applications. When I'm not pushing pixels, you'll find me sipping çay on a terrace overlooking the sea.

projects.title: Coastal Analytics
